                 — entirely in-terminal

                 locally

                 calls)                                                         
    sync         Reconcile your account with a YAML manifest                    
                 (infrastructure-as-code)                                       
    plan         Preview what sync would change (alias for sync --dry-run)      
    apply        Apply a manifest without confirmation prompt (alias for sync   
                 --yes)                                                         
    export       Export your account (or a subset) as a v2 manifest or Terraform
                 HCL
